subject: general
question: The Central Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2023 was passed for the establishment of Sammakka Sarakka Central Tribal University in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On December 14, 2023, Parliament passed the Central Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2023, to establish the Sammakka Sarakka Central Tribal University in Telangana.
 
• The bill received approval from the Rajya Sabha by voice vote, following its clearance in the Lok Sabha the previous week.
 
• Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, during the debate, emphasized that the establishment of this central tribal university is a mandatory provision under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.
 
• The university aims to enhance access and quality of higher education, promote tribal art, culture, and customs, and advance technology for the tribal population of India.
 
• Despite delays in providing land by the Telangana government, the minister assured quick processes post the president's assent for the university to function as a national institution.
 
• This development reflects the government's commitment to tribal welfare and educational progress in the country.
